sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0
sources.released_version_or_commit: 3.0.0; page states latest stable 3.0.0 and previous 2.1.1
sources.observed_operation: Read public specification in browser; no product or remote manifest tested.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Canvas is an HTTP(S) URI without a fragment; width/height define spatial extent; annotation coordinates must stay within bounds. Canvas annotations and painting content use distinct Annotation Page locations; derived transcription may use supplementing. Referenced external resources must be retrievable, but an id is not a guarantee of perpetual availability.
sources.applicability: Page identity, full-page and region targets, transcription records, and separation of annotation data from source images/manifests.
sources.limits: Normative data model and client expectations, not a common editor, storage server, or promise of equal viewer feature support.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0 Change Log
sources.released_version_or_commit: Companion change log for Presentation API 3.0.0
sources.locator: Version 3 changes to annotations/otherContent, context, language/value forms; issue #1262
sources.observed_operation: Read public change log in browser; no conversion executed.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: V3 replaces v2 otherContent/AnnotationList patterns with Annotation Pages via annotations, including supplementing transcription use; v3 has a distinct context and updated JSON-LD forms.
sources.applicability: Source-version adapter and import compatibility across provider collections.
sources.limits: Change history does not establish current support in either viewer.

sources.title: IIIF Cookbook Recipe 0004: Image and Canvas with Differing Dimensions
sources.locator: Recipe explanation of Canvas coordinate space and replacement image dimensions
sources.observed_operation: Read public cookbook recipe in browser.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Canvas dimensions need not equal painted-image pixels; stable larger Canvas dimensions can support a smaller current image and later replacement while preserving locations if the mapping and represented page geometry remain consistent.
sources.applicability: Coordinate strategy for resolution changes across the 100-page pilot.
sources.limits: Does not solve crops, rotation, altered aspect ratio, page-boundary change, or content drift.

sources.title: W3C Web Annotation Data Model
sources.locator: Sections 1.1-1.3 and 4.2.1 Fragment Selector; selector/textual body examples
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Annotations have body and target; SpecificResource selectors identify segments. FragmentSelector is recommended; media fragments include xywh. Selectors/media combinations may be ignored when a consuming application does not handle them.
sources.applicability: Portable text bodies and rectangular region targets in an exportable record model.
sources.limits: Data interoperability does not guarantee a viewer can author, render, store, or import a given annotation.

sources.title: IIIF Image API 3.0
sources.locator: Sections 3-5 and 7-8: identifier, region/size, Image Information, profiles, CORS and authentication
sources.observed_operation: Read public specification in browser; no image endpoint requested.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Service advertises compliance level and features; static/minimal services may offer only listed sizes; clients must not assume unsupported features. CORS/authentication and provider response status affect browser retrieval.
sources.applicability: Assess external image availability, dimensions, allowed region/size requests, download policy and rights per source.
sources.limits: No actual collection endpoint, access policy, or image/master was tested.

sources.title: IIIF Content State API 1.0
sources.released_version_or_commit: 1.0.0; page states latest stable 1.0.0 and previous 0.9
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Content State can identify a Manifest, Canvas, or Canvas part for viewer initialization and transfer; clients choose which protocol/UI forms to support. It is distinct from viewer-specific UI state.
sources.applicability: Optional shareable page/region deep links across compatible viewers.
sources.limits: Not annotation body storage or annotation import/export.
